name: Carrier Duel — Philippine Sea
description: Two carrier strike groups meet in open water east of Luzon. Blue: US strike group (Ford + Nimitz flight I + escorts). Red: Chinese strike group (Fujian + Shandong + escorts). Both sides start 240 nm apart at opposite corners, all units in cruise formation with standing CAP and AEW pickets. Pure carrier-versus-carrier duel: find the enemy first, strike first, and keep your own deck alive. Fixed seed for reproducible study. Coastline legality correction (2026-10-20): all forces, routes and mission points translated together -20nm east/8nm north; relative geometry unchanged.
